name: codeforge
description: CodeForge — free-first autonomous software engineering agent for Windows, CLI, and editors.

scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings --ignore-pattern tests/evidence/** packages apps tests scripts
scripts.test:postgres: node scripts/postgres-test-harness.mjs -- node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run packages/cloud-db/test/postgres.test.ts
scripts.test:postgres:full: node scripts/postgres-test-harness.mjs -- node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/two-client-authority.test.ts tests/cloud-postgres-adversarial.test.ts tests/fg1-postgres-ledger.test.ts tests/migration-namespace-collision.test.ts packages/cloud-db/test/publication-lease.test.ts packages/cloud-db/test/postgres.test.ts packages/cloud-db/test/parity.test.ts packages/cloud-db/test/account-deletion.test.ts packages/server/test/cf17-pg-restart-e2e.test.ts packages/server/test/hosted-workflow-postgres-r4.test.ts packages/server/test/fg7-postgres-persistence.test.ts packages/eight-bit/test/postgres.test.ts
scripts.security:gate: node scripts/security/secret-scan.mjs --self-test --scan && node scripts/security/audit-dependencies.mjs && node scripts/security/public-claims-scan.mjs && node scripts/security/validate-doc-links.mjs
scripts.security:tests: vitest run packages/crypto packages/secrets packages/cloud-auth packages/cloud-billing tests/security apps/desktop/test/electron-security-baseline.test.ts apps/desktop/test/secure-credential-codec.test.ts packages/server/test/network-exposure.test.ts
